simple.prompt: Our finance department ___ all reimbursement requests on Fridays.
simple.explanation: Department adalah noun tunggal (setara dengan 'it') dan berakhiran -ss, sehingga ditambah -es menjadi 'processes'.
hints: Verb berakhiran -ss mendapat akhiran -es untuk subject tunggal.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tentang jadwal keberangkatan pesawat ini.
simple.targetSentence: The flight leaves at seven every morning.
simple.explanation: Jadwal rutin memakai Present Simple; 'The flight' (tunggal) memakai 'leaves'.

simple.prompt: My colleague ___ a short status update every afternoon at four.
simple.explanation: 'My colleague' adalah orang ketiga tunggal (he/she), sehingga verb 'send' ditambah -s menjadi 'sends'.
hints: Present Simple subjek tunggal memakai akhiran -s.

simple.prompt: The museum ___ free admission to students on Tuesdays.
simple.explanation: 'The museum' adalah benda tunggal ('it'), jadi gunakan 'offers'.

simple.prompt: Our delivery drivers ___ all routes before seven in the morning.
simple.explanation: Subjek jamak 'Our delivery drivers' menggunakan kata kerja bentuk dasar 'check'.
hints: Subjek jamak tidak memakai akhiran -s pada verb.

simple.prompt: Water ___ at 0 degrees Celsius under normal atmospheric pressure.
simple.explanation: Fakta ilmiah selalu memakai Present Simple; subjek tak terhitung 'Water' setara 'it', sehingga memakai 'freezes'.

simple.prompt: He always ___ his luggage carefully before an international flight.
simple.explanation: Verb berakhiran -k cukup ditambah -s untuk subjek 'He': 'packs'.

simple.prompt: Rina ___ her emails and ___ client calls every morning.
simple.explanation: Kedua verb berbagi subjek orang ketiga tunggal 'Rina', sehingga keduanya mendapat akhiran -s: 'reads / answers'.

simple.prompt: That courier service ___ packages across thirty provinces.
simple.explanation: Verb 'carry' berakhiran konsonan r + y, sehingga untuk subjek tunggal berubah menjadi 'carries'.

simple.prompt: Our main branch ___ a dedicated customer service lounge on the ground floor.
simple.explanation: Untuk subjek tunggal ('Our main branch'), kata kerja tidak beraturan 'have' berubah menjadi 'has'.

simple.prompt: The workshop presenter ___ clearly so every participant follows easily.
simple.explanation: Subjek tunggal 'The workshop presenter' memakai verb + -s: 'speaks'.

simple.prompt: My grandparents ___ fresh vegetables in their garden every weekend.
simple.explanation: 'My grandparents' adalah subjek jamak (they), sehingga verb tetap bentuk dasar 'grow'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang rutinitas akhir pekan.
dialogue: Lina
What does your brother usually do on Saturdays?
Arman
He ___ football with his college friends.
simple.explanation: Kata 'play' berakhiran vokal a + y, sehingga untuk 'He' cukup ditambah -s menjadi 'plays'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi dialog singkat tentang kebiasaan sarapan.
dialogue: Host
Do you and your sister drink tea in the morning?
Guest
No, we usually ___ black coffee instead.
simple.explanation: Subjek 'we' menggunakan kata kerja bentuk dasar 'drink'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan akhiran verb pada kalimat rutinitas berikut.
simple.draft: The local bakery bake fresh sourdough bread every morning at six.
options: The local bakery bakes fresh sourdough bread every morning at six.
The local bakery is bake fresh sourdough bread every morning at six.
The local bakery baking fresh sourdough bread every morning at six.
simple.explanation: 'The local bakery' adalah subjek tunggal (it), sehingga verb 'bake' wajib ditambah -s menjadi 'bakes'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat fakta sederhana tentang jam buka kantor.
simple.targetSentence: The reception desk opens at eight every weekday.
simple.explanation: Jadwal tetap menggunakan Present Simple; 'The reception desk' tunggal memakai 'opens'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat kebiasaan yang menggunakan subjek jamak.
simple.targetSentence: They review safety procedures every Monday morning.
hints: Akhiri dengan keterangan waktu 'every Monday morning'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi pertanyaan dalam dialog wawancara kerja ini.
dialogue: HR
___ your current team use project management software?
Candidate
Yes, we use it every day to track tasks.
intermediate.explanation: 'Your current team' adalah subject tunggal, sehingga pertanyaan Present Simple memakai auxiliary 'Does'.
hints: Periksa subject 'your current team' (tunggal) dan main verb 'use'.
Pertanyaan dengan verb dasar 'use' untuk subject tunggal memakai 'Does'.

intermediate.prompt: My supervisor ___ work on public holidays unless there is an emergency.
intermediate.explanation: Main verb aksi 'work' untuk subjek tunggal 'My supervisor' membutuhkan auxiliary negatif 'doesn't'.
hints: Apakah ada main verb aksi ('work') setelahnya?

intermediate.prompt: Does the shuttle bus ___ directly in front of Terminal 2?
intermediate.explanation: Karena auxiliary 'Does' sudah menandai orang ketiga tunggal, main verb harus kembali ke bentuk dasar murni: 'stop'.

intermediate.prompt: Where ___ your parents spend their winter holidays every year?
intermediate.explanation: 'Your parents' berbentuk jamak (they), sehingga pertanyaan dengan main verb 'spend' memakai auxiliary 'do'.

intermediate.prompt: She ___ usually check social media during working hours.
intermediate.explanation: Untuk subjek 'She' dengan main verb 'check', gunakan auxiliary negatif 'doesn't' sebelum adverb 'usually'.

intermediate.prompt: ___ your new tablet support a Bluetooth stylus?
intermediate.explanation: 'Your new tablet' adalah benda tunggal ('it') dan main verb-nya 'support', maka pertanyaan diawali 'Does'.

intermediate.prompt: Our branch office ___ offer walk-in consultations on weekends.
intermediate.explanation: Subjek tunggal 'Our branch office' memakai 'doesn't' + bentuk dasar 'offer'.

intermediate.prompt: How frequently ___ the IT team run automated backups?
intermediate.explanation: Dalam frasa 'the IT team' sebagai satu unit tunggal, pertanyaan memakai 'does' + base verb 'run'.
hints: 'The IT team' diperlakukan sebagai satu kesatuan tunggal.

intermediate.prompt: Do all passengers need to show their boarding passes? — Yes, they ___.
intermediate.explanation: Jawaban singkat harus cocok dengan auxiliary pertanyaan ('Do' + 'they') menjadi 'Yes, they do.'
hints: Sesuaikan jawaban singkat dengan subjek 'they' dan kata tanya 'Do'.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih posisi frequency adverb 'often' yang paling tepat.
options: He often arrives ten minutes early.
He arrives often ten minutes early.
Often he arrives is ten minutes early.
intermediate.explanation: Dengan kata kerja biasa ('arrives'), frequency adverb seperti 'often' diletakkan tepat sebelum main verb.
hints: Adverb of frequency berada di antara subjek dan main verb biasa.

intermediate.prompt: Why ___ this software crash whenever I export large charts?
intermediate.explanation: Subjek 'this software' (tak terhitung/tunggal) bersama main verb 'crash' memakai 'does'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang jadwal operasional apotek.
dialogue: Customer
Does the pharmacy stay open past midnight?
Clerk
No, it ___. We close at eleven every night.
intermediate.explanation: Pertanyaan diawali 'Does' dengan subjek tunggal 'it', sehingga jawaban singkat negatifnya 'No, it doesn't.'
hints: Cocokkan auxiliary pertanyaan ('Does') pada jawaban singkat.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog di meja layanan pelanggan.
dialogue: Agent
Do you receive our weekly newsletter?
Client
Actually, no. I ___ get any messages from your system.
intermediate.explanation: Subjek 'I' dengan main verb 'get' menggunakan bentuk negatif 'don't'.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan umum auxiliary ganda pada kalimat negatif berikut.
intermediate.draft: The accounting intern doesn't submits invoices without approval.
options: The accounting intern doesn't submit invoices without approval.
The accounting intern don't submit invoices without approval.
The accounting intern isn't submits invoices without approval.
intermediate.explanation: Setelah auxiliary 'doesn't', kata kerja wajib kembali ke bentuk dasar murni 'submit' tanpa akhiran -s.
hints: Sudah ada 'doesn't', jadi akhiran -s pada verb harus dilepas.

intermediate.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan bentuk pertanyaan tanpa auxiliary berikut.
intermediate.draft: Where your sister works during the summer break?
options: Where does your sister work during the summer break?
Where do your sister works during the summer break?
Where does your sister works during the summer break?
intermediate.explanation: Pertanyaan Wh- dalam Present Simple memerlukan auxiliary 'does' sebelum subjek tunggal 'your sister', dan verb kembali ke bentuk dasar 'work'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun pertanyaan Present Simple menggunakan 'Why' dan 'doesn't'.
intermediate.targetSentence: Why doesn't the projector connect to my laptop?
intermediate.explanation: Urutan pertanyaan negatif: Wh-word + doesn't + Subject + base verb + complement?
hints: Tambahkan verb dasar 'connect' lalu 'to my laptop?'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya dengan kata keterangan frekuensi.
intermediate.targetSentence: Does your manager usually review reports on Friday?
intermediate.explanation: Frequency adverb 'usually' berada tepat setelah subjek dan sebelum main verb 'review' dalam pertanyaan.

complex.prompt: Sunting kalimat email operasional berikut agar sesuai kaidah Present Simple.
complex.draft: The warehouse don't opens on public holidays, so deliveries wait until Monday.
options: The warehouse doesn't open on public holidays, so deliveries wait until Monday.
The warehouse doesn't opens on public holidays, so deliveries waits until Monday.
The warehouse isn't open on public holidays, so deliveries are waiting every Monday.
hints: Periksa kesesuaian subject tunggal 'The warehouse' dengan auxiliary negatif.
Setelah 'doesn't', verb kembali ke bentuk dasar tanpa -s.

complex.prompt: Our clinic usually ___ at eight, but today technicians ___ the X-ray machine, so we open at nine.
complex.explanation: Rutinitas biasa memakai Present Simple ('opens'); kegiatan perbaikan sementara hari ini memakai Present Continuous ('are servicing').
hints: Bedakan rutinitas ('usually') vs situasi sementara hari ini ('today').

complex.prompt: Look at the departure board: Flight GA-402 ___ at 14:35 tomorrow afternoon.
complex.explanation: Jadwal penerbangan dan transportasi publik yang tetap menggunakan Present Simple meskipun waktunya esok hari.
hints: Jadwal resmi pesawat tetap memakai Present Simple.

complex.prompt: I ___ your point about shipping costs, even though I disagree with the proposed timeline.
complex.explanation: Ketika 'see' bermakna memahami atau menangkap maksud secara mental (stative verb), gunakan Present Simple ('I see'), bukan continuous.

complex.prompt: Which sentence correctly uses a stative verb of ownership?
options: This logistics hub is belonging to a regional cooperative.
This logistics hub belongs to a regional cooperative.
This logistics hub belong to a regional cooperative.
complex.explanation: Kata kerja kepemilikan seperti 'belong', 'own', dan 'possess' adalah stative verb sehingga tidak dipakai dalam bentuk -ing.

complex.prompt: Pilih posisi frequency adverb yang benar bersama kata kerja to be.
options: The reception area is never unattended during business hours.
The reception area never is unattended during business hours.
Never the reception area is unattended during business hours.
complex.explanation: Saat main verb-nya adalah 'be' (am/is/are), adverb of frequency ('never', 'always', 'usually') diletakkan SESUDAH to be.

complex.prompt: The museum's main gallery closes at six, yet the rooftop café ___ open until nine every evening.
complex.explanation: Kondisi dan jam buka tetap yang berlaku rutin setiap malam memakai Present Simple: 'stays'.

complex.prompt: At the moment, the marketing director ___ in Tokyo, where she usually ___ two regional seminars a year.
complex.explanation: 'At the moment' menandai kondisi sementara ('is staying'), sedangkan 'usually ... a year' menandai kebiasaan berulang ('leads').
hints: Klausa pertama bersifat sementara saat ini.

complex.prompt: Notice the semantic shift: 'He ___ the candidates carefully right now' vs 'His voice ___ calm.'
complex.explanation: 'Weigh' bermakna aksi menimbang/menilai saat ini ('is weighing'); 'sound' sebagai linking/stative verb kesan memakai Present Simple ('sounds').

complex.prompt: Whenever a shipment ___ delayed at customs, our coordinator immediately notifies the buyer.
complex.explanation: Fakta prosedural umum dengan 'Whenever' selalu memakai Present Simple ('is'), menyatakan kondisi rutin setiap kali terjadi.

complex.prompt: Why ___ you always suspect that something goes wrong?
complex.explanation: 'Suspect' adalah stative verb pikiran, sehingga pertanyaan Present Simple untuk 'you' wajib memakai auxiliary 'do'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog perbedaan jadwal tetap vs rencana rapat mendadak.
dialogue: Coordinator
When does the autumn semester start?
Registrar
Official classes ___ on September 1, even though orientation takes place earlier.
complex.explanation: Jadwal akademik resmi memakai Present Simple; subjek jamak 'Official classes' memakai verb dasar 'begin'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan yang membedakan stative 'taste' dan dynamic 'taste'.
dialogue: Sous-chef
Why are you tasting the reduction again?
Head Chef
I ___ it to check the salt level, and honestly, it ___ slightly sweet already.
complex.explanation: Aksi mencicipi sengaja saat ini memakai continuous ('am tasting'), sedangkan cita rasa sifat sup tersebut memakai stative verb ('tastes').
hints: Bagian pertama adalah tindakan aktif mencicipi.
Bagian kedua mendeskripsikan sifat rasa makanan.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan umum pemakaian Present Continuous untuk stative verb dan rutinitas.
complex.draft: Currently I am knowing three programming languages, and every weekend I am building small tools.
options: Currently I know three programming languages, and every weekend I build small tools.
Currently I know three programming languages, and every weekend I am building small tools.
Currently I am knowing three programming languages, and every weekend I build small tools.
complex.explanation: 'Know' adalah stative verb pengetahuan (pakai 'know', bukan 'am knowing'), dan 'every weekend' menandakan kebiasaan rutin ('build').
hints: Periksa kata kerja 'know' (keadaan) dan penanda waktu 'every weekend'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan perpaduan jadwal dan auxiliary dalam laporan kerja berikut.
complex.draft: The evening ferry don't arrive at nine anymore; it is leaving at 8:30 sharp every day.
options: The evening ferry doesn't arrive at nine anymore; it leaves at 8:30 sharp every day.
The evening ferry doesn't arrives at nine anymore; it leaves at 8:30 sharp every day.
The evening ferry isn't arrive at nine anymore; it leaves at 8:30 sharp every day.
complex.explanation: 'The evening ferry' tunggal memakai 'doesn't arrive' (verb dasar), dan jadwal tetap harian memakai 'leaves' (bukan 'is leaving').
hints: Cek subject tunggal dengan 'doesn't' + base verb.
Jadwal transportasi harian memakai Present Simple 'leaves'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat yang memadukan kebiasaan umum dengan pengecualian sementara.
complex.targetSentence: We usually host clients onsite, but today we are meeting online.
complex.explanation: Kebiasaan memakai 'usually host'; pengecualian sementara 'today' memakai 'are meeting'.
hints: Mulai dengan klausa kebiasaan 'We usually host clients onsite,'.
Hubungkan dengan 'but today we are meeting online'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat ber-stative verb dengan kata keterangan frekuensi.
complex.targetSentence: This warehouse always contains enough emergency supplies.
complex.explanation: Subjek tunggal 'This warehouse' memakai adverb 'always' sebelum stative verb 'contains'.
